status: PASS focused static review of private native v2 register-only persistent candidate; no concrete source-backed blocker found
scope: Frozen v1 native adapter/header/XNU binding plus v2 whole sweet_touch source copy. Frozen phase10 completion and phase7 retain reviews are not repeated. Production-named integration, linkage, CI and hardware are outside this review.
findings: The XNU hook is selected only by nord2wifi=2 plus nord2wifipersist=1 at the existing owned power window. A separate persistent lifetime latch is set before the first native MMIO write; restoration, Linux return and reentry reject retained state. Refusal before the first adapter write follows the existing outer restoration path; uncertain or dirty results after mutation panic without teardown.

Adapter cold checks repeatedly require live AP/readability and positive SPM RC selection, source reset/power/master-idle predicates and the outer owner proof. It excludes a generic SPI-busy predicate during an owned in-flight command. Source HOST remap is written in order (CONN, WF, BT, GPS, optional MCIF), masked to 20 bits and read back before the frozen core starts. CONN 0x8fb00000 and MCIF 0x8a000000 are parent-accepted historical register-only provenance; no DRAM aperture is mapped.

The backend maps exact AP/CONN register pages and 16 KiB cold subsystem SYSRAM only. Callback address/mask allowlists cover the frozen source operations. Semaphore 11/19 acquisition and release, TOP-only SPI address list and bounded pre/post-trigger busy polling preserve a failed or ambiguous command as fatal, without replay or forced release. The final CKGEN bit23 clear latches terminal handoff before the write; only the source PWRCTRL0 read and OR-bit0 write are permitted afterward, with no further CONN or AP check.

Selected conninfra/Kbuild:115 defines CONNINFRA_PLAT_BUILD_MODE=3, also observed in saved Android dmesg:1875. V2 passes build=3 so the core writes the selected D-die build word before source SYSRAM clearing. The v1 build=0 mismatch is resolved.

Selected MT6893 RC PMIC path initializes VCN18 before VCN13: OP_EN/OP_CFG fields, SW_LP bit1, then regulator enable bit0. V2 splits only persistent slots 2 and 5 into checked low-bit transitions 0->2->3 with serialized PMIF full-word readback. Existing VCN13 selector guard 0x202e & 0xf0f == 0x400 establishes 1.3 V; VCN18 is fixed 1.8 V. The original diagnostic PMIC helper is unchanged.

Saved vendor conninfra.cfg contains co_clock_flag=1 and pre_cal_mode=3 but no tcxo_gpio; selected conninfra_conf_init zeroes the full configuration before parsing, so tcxo_gpio remains 0. Selected mt6893.c:282-285 chooses 26M_COTMS, not the GPIO155 EXTCXO branch. Selected clock-buffer call documents hardware control with software status update; no additional TCXO register write is source-backed for this selected configuration.

The saved legacy EMI observer's unsupported SMC/read result does not change this reset-held register-only remap/SYSRAM source sequence. This review does not authorize DRAM reads/writes, firmware placement, DMA, WFSYS/BGFSYS CPU release, RF or network operation.
validation_examined: Author's native-bound v2 log reports 269468 successful backend callbacks, 11 focused fault samples, 14 address fault pairs, bounded SPI/clock cases and default-off/reentry/base guards; extracted PMIC helper log reports both rail orders and 12 callback-failure positions. V2 whole source ARM64 object compile is recorded in manifest. I inspected source and exact hashes but did not repeat broad tests or independently link a kernel.
limitations: Static and host-mock evidence only. Real PMIC, CONN MMIO electrical response, software-uninterruptible bus stalls, final HW-control behavior, suspend/reboot coordination and image/device health require later bounded integration and explicit image approval. Production-named copy and active-tree integration were not part of this frozen-input review.
